name: English
meta: Areopagus: a European network of real people. Built in the open, together.
kicker: A European network of real people
lead: Areopagus gives everyone a page, every town a map and every person a voice. No ads, open code. The network is only starting, and you can build it with us.
stationText: Areopagus is also a legend: an orbital station that all of humanity builds. It is named after the hill in Athens where the apostle Paul spoke with the philosophers in their own language (Acts 17). Cargo ships carry everything for the building up from the Earth, and anyone can send cargo. The crew of the station are Christians, and they serve the common work: they meet on board to agree on the affairs of the Earth and go back to work below, so that the Earth becomes a garden for all who live on it.
stationVerse: Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven
earthText: Open to everyone. Each person has a space for earthly things: a page, a home port, skills, a logbook, questions, communities. Everyone can see what the station does and where it is heading.
aboardText: The station is the home of the crew, Christians who serve the common work. The way aboard is being prepared and will be published after a legal review. The station takes a person at their word and does not judge anyone's faith.
stationNote: The picture is close to how such a station could really be built: two rings with a radius of 250 m turn in opposite directions at 1.9 turns a minute, which gives the weight we have on Earth, 800 km above it. One ring is always being built.
pathText: What is done is lit. What is in work pulses. What is planned is an outline. No dates here, only an honest order.
nodes: A legal home for the project
joinText: Nobody is ranked here. Every release names all who had a hand in it, in alphabetical order.
ways: Add an idea. It appears on the path as an outline next to its branch.
One voice per person per idea. Numbers belong to ideas, never to people.
Translation, testing on your phone, data about your town, code.
Join the circle that gets new things before everyone else.
For one step of the path or for keeping the network running.
supText: One number matters: until which month the network is paid for. For now the project is run by its founder as a sole trader in France, so support is his business income, not a charitable gift.
rules: Every euro in and every euro out goes into a public journal anyone can verify.
A donation buys no voting weight, no placement and no badge.
Your name is shown only if you ask for it.
engText: Areopagus is also an engine. Your space, shop or community can live on your own domain by subscription. The code is open, so anyone may run it themselves for free.
foot: Open code under AGPL. Data in Europe. No ads, ever.
